prompt: Two measurements are recorded as $P = 50\text{ m}$ and $Q = 50\text{ s}$. State one way in which these two records are similar, and one fundamental way in which they differ physically.
answer: Similarity: Both measurements share the same numerical magnitude (50). Difference: They have different units and describe different physical quantities (P is a length, Q is a time).

mark_scheme.criterion: States that both have the same numerical magnitude (50).
States that they represent different physical quantities or have different units (metres is length, seconds is time).

hints: Look at the unit symbols and the physical properties they measure.
solution:

Difference: They have different measurement units (metres versus seconds) and describe completely different physical quantities (length versus time).
